project_type: React + Vite + TypeScript SPA with Supabase Edge Functions (Deno)
build_system: Vite for frontend, Supabase Edge Functions (Deno runtime) for backend
verification_instructions: Run tsc --noEmit for the frontend. Edge Functions are Deno and don't have a local type-check step, but verify syntax is valid.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Edge Functions use Deno runtime (jsr: imports, Deno.env, Deno.serve). Frontend uses Node/Vite.
key_patterns: All Edge Functions import from '../_shared/openrouter.ts' using { callLLM, hasKey }. The shared module exports callLLM(messages, jsonMode, maxTokens) and hasKey(). proxy-ai is a standalone gateway that calls OpenRouter directly (does not use _shared/openrouter.ts). proxy-tts calls OpenRouter TTS API directly.
directory_structure: supabase/functions/ contains all Edge Functions, each in its own directory with index.ts. _shared/ has common utilities (openrouter.ts, cors.ts, iaCredits.ts, rateLimit.ts, blackbox.ts). Frontend is in src/ with features/ directory.
